messages:
Alex W: Heads up — we saw a p99 tail spike after yesterday's 3x traffic burst on the dedicated pool. Looks like a KV miss flood + kernel fallback. attaching quick traces.

Priya S: confirming — is this on the 8k seq models or 2k? p99 numbers?

Alex W: 8k. p50 ~120ms, p95 ~360ms, p99 jumped to ~2.1s for ~10% of requests during scale-up window.

autoscale-bot: [scale event] scaled from 8 -> 12 replicas at 2026-02-15T18:21:22Z (scale-latency 4.2s) :gear:

Samir: hmm 4.2s scale lag explains some cold KV misses. Did kernel selector pick a fallback kernel when batch underfilled?

Alex W: yes. profiler snippet:
```
kernel_selected: attention_opt_v1
fallback: attention_generic
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.28 -> 0.60 after 20s
microbatch_size: 1 -> 4
prober_sample_rate: 0.03
```

Jia L: attention_opt_v1 is faster when batch>=4 and cache warmed. With microbatches of 1 we see bad path and fallback. Microbatch sizing + prober jitter look suspicious.

Priya S: did we deploy new kernel binary or change selector rules in the last rollout?

Margo: Canary yesterday was the same kernel set. What changed was routing: ~30% of burst traffic hit fresh pods that weren't prewarmed, and the prober sampling/aggregation got noisier.

Alex W: repro plan: 1) run perf-prober with KV prefetch enabled 2) simulate a 3x QPS burst with seq-dist matching production 3) collect kernel decisions + batch hist + kv_hit_rate.

Samir: also try forcing microbatch_min=2 and microbatch_wait_ms=6 to reduce underfilled path. See if p99 drops.

Priya S: I'll schedule the probe and attach heap/pprof + flame graphs. Adding short alert: kv_hit_rate<0.4 during scale events :rotating_light:.

autoscale-bot: [note] experiment started by Priya S at 1768882100

Margo: If repro is consistent we can add a short "burst runway" preheat (prober-driven warmup) and tune prober sample_size down to avoid noisy fallback. Also consider quick KV prefetch on new pods.

Alex W: good. I'll run the microbatch_min tweak first and post results. If that helps, we can make it an autoscaler experiment.

Jia L: I have a replay script that reproduces seq distribution and token lengths. Ping me and I'll run it with the probe.

Samir: +1 to replay. Also capture kernel perf counters (L2 misses, compute stalls). Sometimes selector falls back because of transient resource pressure.

Alex W: action items: Priya run probe + collect traces, Samir run replay + perf counters, Jia provide script, Margo review rollout/routing. Target: next 48h.

Priya S: ack

Samir: ack

Jia L: ack

Margo: ack
